name: Gemeente Utrecht
description: Gemeente Utrecht's own design tokens, from @utrecht/design-tokens: dark blue buttons and links on white.
_comment_source: Derived from @utrecht/design-tokens 8.1.0 (https://registry.npmjs.org/@utrecht/design-tokens/-/design-tokens-8.1.0.tgz), Ruben's decision of 19 Nov 2026.
A partial brand file: the package's own --utrecht-* component mapping (the .utrecht-theme rule, without its
dark-mode and viewport overrides) is section B, and the role layer adds only what carries no colour. The
ramp is empty because the package colours its own components. Every semantic colour below is a value the
package assigns to that role, converted from its hsl() to hex (round to nearest per channel), because the
contrast engine reads hex. A role the package does not colour is left out, so Nextcloud keeps its own.

semantic._comment: From: button-primary-action background (blue-35), its colour (white) and hover (blue-40); link (blue-35) and link focus (blue-40); document colour (black); feedback-danger (red-40); separator (blue-90).
